history.summary: A 1BR in CDL's Amber Park (freehold, 2023) — 250m to TE25 Tanjong Katong MRT in prime D15 East Coast. At $2,584 PSF it's actually below the $2,910 project median and below the ~$2,684+ live 1BR listings, but the resale-only appreciation is a thin 1.7%/yr and the $2,584 PSF absolute is steep, balancing to Neutral.
history.rating_rationale: Entry $2,584 PSF vs $2,910.5 URA median = -11% and below recent transacted 1BR pricing (~$2,684-3,049 PSF observed in 2025) — value is reasonable for the project. Deep 283-txn base, 250m to the new TE25 station, established CDL freehold. But new_launch_bias=true and the honest resale-only rate is just 1.71%/yr; the blended 3.48% is developer-inflated per the rubric. 1BR niche pool plus a high $2,584 PSF cap the upside. Quality address, fair price, soft growth signal.
